thread:
Ana (partnerships): Quick sync on ISV Sprint 0 — inventory + announce cadence. Goal: get 3 adapters listed on marketplaces and a joint blog + one-pager. Thoughts?
Mike (eng): +1. Need the API compatibility checklist from eng and a minimal smoke-test harness.
Sophie (solutions): Can owners confirm healthcheck surface + auth patterns? We'll need a tiny LangChain/LlamaIndex example app.
David (product): Proposed announce cadence: wave 1 = partner beta (soft), wave 2 = public marketplace listing + joint webinar.
Mike (eng): Technical TODOs: package as wheel + docker image, support API key and OAuth optional, add smoke/e2e tests, CI job for adapter. Quick install: `pip install redwood-adapter-example`
Mike (eng): Example minimal manifest snippet: ```json
{"name": "redwood-orchx-adapter", "version": "0.1.0", "routing": {"policy": "latency", "fallback": "gpt-compat"}}
```
Ana (partnerships): Timeline proposal: Week1 = inventory + partner contacts, Week2 = eng + docs, Week3 = marketplace listing + PR, Week4 = joint webinar + case writeup. @Sophie can you drive docs and sample app?
Sophie (solutions): I'll own docs + sample prompts. Also will create an OrchX (orchestration tool) integration example and a tiny notebook for LlamaIndex.
Integrations Bot: Created ticket INT-4321 and assigned to Mike (eng) for CI and packaging.
Mike (eng): CI added. Run smoke locally: `pytest tests/integration/test_orchx_adapter.py -k smoke`
David (product): For marketing/announcements we need partner logos, 2 partner quotes, and ideally 1 joint customer blurb. Sophie — can you collect?
Sophie (solutions): I'll ping LangChain contact and the LlamaIndex guild today. Will add ask template.
Ana (partnerships): Risk flags: marketplace listings need legal signoff + CLA. @David can you loop legal in?
David (product): Looping legal now. Also need feature flags for canary rollout and a rollback playbook.
Mike (eng): Routing config example (add to docs): ```json
{"routes": [{"path": "/generate","model": "rw-compat-1","fallback": "rw-compat-2"}], "batching": {"enabled": true, "max_tokens": 512}}
```
Sophie (solutions): UX note for marketplace tile: call out "Dedicated + Private compatible" and include performance numbers (p99 latency on sample workload).
Ana (partnerships): OK — next sync Friday 10am PT. I'll send calendar invite and attach the sprint checklist. :thumbsup:
summary: Sprint 0 kickoff for ISV adapters: inventory, packaging, docs, marketplace cadence, legal and marketing asks
